name: Sweep Orphaned Tmp Files
description: Remove orphaned .tmp files left by crashed atomic write operations in workspace directories.

name: Qdrant Health Check
description: Monitor Qdrant liveness (/healthz), collection status and optimizer health. Attempt a non-interactive service restart when Qdrant is down, a collection is red or the optimizer is stuck; exit non-zero (restart requires operator) when the restart is denied or fails.
